_doc: The owner's rulings on what this ship removes from live on purpose (docs/plan/HANDOFF.md, 'Ruled by the owner', 2026-10-02). tools/ship/prune.mjs reads this file and lists every item a ruling names in its plan, with the ruling's words, beside the import's own stale items. A ruling never removes an item a write that was not an import touched (a person's own filing through the MCP is kept and listed). A ruling names a project, a kind (or kinds), and either explicit keys or stale: true (every item of those kinds the build no longer files).

rulings.ruling: ryuklabs' private data (client names with amounts, funding details) is stripped, on live too (owner, 2026-10-02)
two of siru's gap nodes the brain no longer files go with the ship (owner, 2026-10-02)
the old brain's model and its old goal tree are removed from live, replaced by the code layout, with no sharingu snapshot first (owner, 2026-10-02)
